findings.text: The filed-record read now accepts any status in RECOGNISED_REVIEW_STATUSES ({"parsed", "unparsed", "incomplete"}), where the base commit accepted only "parsed". That set is the store's validation vocabulary, not the set a reader selects on: reckon/crew/review.py:836 states plainly that "A reader acts on ``parsed`` alone, so a record carrying any other status is one no reader acts on", and every selecting reader in the tree uses the literal — promotion_checks.py:1114 (`not (review and review.get("status") == "parsed")`) and recovery_review_subject.py:1208 (`review.get("status") != "parsed"`). The only other importer of the set, recovery_review_subject.py:460, uses it to format a list of accepted statuses, a validation use. So a review run that exited having filed an `unparsed` record (no SCORE line recognised) or an `incomplete` one (the revision pair could not identify the diff) now classifies promotable — the fleet row's action reads "promote the completed review run" — while the promotion gate at promotion_checks.py:1114 refuses to let that same record satisfy a review gate. The plan section's own measure names the narrower condition ("filed a record that parses"; done-when "a parsed filed record"), and the node's goal is worded "filed a parsed review record", so this is broader than both. The broadening was introduced by this diff (commit 39a8321c3), is untested — every fixture writes PARSED_REVIEW — and reverses the direction of the prior review's finding, which named the literal as drift without asking what the imported set means.

The module docstring was edited from "the review it files" to "the review it serves", which is not a word that describes this mechanism; the sentence continues "and the filing survives on the shared home", so the intended verb is "files". A cosmetic slip introduced by commit 39a8321c3.

The docstring sentence re-wrapped mid-clause: line 193 ends "the attempt the run's" and line 194 begins "own marker names", leaving a dangling fragment that reads as a broken sentence in the module's own description of the attempt key. Introduced by commit 39a8321c3; the text should re-flow into two whole lines.
